title: Travis Walton case fire-tower debunk disputed

tellings.quote: And there and they talk about this fire tower and it's like it was right next to the road. It's like, no, it's not. It's over a hill.

plain: In 1975 a man named Travis Walton went missing in the Arizona woods, and his case is told as an alien abduction. Skeptics have explained the light his work crew saw as a fire lookout tower standing right next to the road. The writer and researcher Greg Bishop rejects that on Michels's show, saying the tower is not next to the road at all but over a hill, so the explanation does not work.
